Class HistoricalIntervention

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.events.HistoricalIntervention
public class HistoricalIntervention extends Object
Encapsulates an exogenous or procedural historical leader intervention. Modifies local geographic physics (H3Cell) and sovereign cliodynamic properties (Nation) across an active spatio-temporal radius.
